purpose: Choose and time a supported gesture
rules: Wave, reach and celebrate are the available variants. Reach is expressive posing, not a guaranteed grasp/contact.
Gesture controls blend from rest and back using an explicit envelope. Leave a hold before the next gesture.
Longer intervals slow the gesture; do not stretch unsupported physical actions into this vocabulary.
For a wave, keep the arm silhouette separate from the head and review multiple frames for direction/readability.
Gesture and expression may overlap, but two gestures on one actor may not.
inspection: Playable preview plus contact sheet/action-boundary frames; human or vision review for appeal.
stop: Stop when requested effect is reviewed or workflow budget is exhausted.
